instruction.text: Match the figure of speech with its definition.

b.sound: is a direct comparison; one thing directly compared to another
compares two things with one another with like or as
emphasizes a point with an exaggeration
use figurative language to express a widely accepted fact about life
expression where the meaning goes beyond the literal definition of the words
where an idea or thing is given human-like qualities such as emotion

instruction.text: Which figure of speech is this? Choose the correct answer.

atoms.a: Her hair was as white as snow.

Yolanda’s hair was as soft as a feather.
Leo has a heart of gold.
You can’t make an omelette without breaking a few eggs.
He called me a million times yesterday.
That was the worst day of my life.
